info.synopsis: La storia di mafia si svolge in pieno proibizionismo. Nel distretto di Lawless, lo Stato non è di casa ed è la mafia a governarne le strade, qui l?alcol di contrabbando scorre liberamente. Una volta Avilo viveva nel distretto insieme alla sua famiglia, ma durante una guerra tra clan, i suoi genitori e il suo fratellino furono assassinati. Da allora il protagonista è fuggito ed è rimasto nascosto sotto copertura. Sette anni dopo Avilo riceve una lettera da uno sconosciuto misterioso, il suo contenuto accende in lui un?insaziabile fame di vendetta. Così la ricerca di rivalsa lo riporterà a Lawless, ove si infiltrerà nelle fila dei gangster della famiglia Vanetti, allo scopo di avvicinare e uccidere Nero e suo padre, il boss? Questo è il diario di 91 giorni votati alla vendetta, un ?revenge drama? lungo 91 giorni!
info.title: 91 Days

info.synopsis: Il "One Outs" è un gioco di scommesse clandestine, relativamente al Baseball, il cui campione imbattuto è Tokuchi Toua. Il battitore Hiromichi Kojima, stella dei Lycaons, recandosi ad Okinawa per sottoporsi ad un particolare allenamento, si troverà , a causa delle vicissitudini, a scommettere ben 400.000 dollari in una sfida contro lo stesso Toua, lanciatore infallibile. Quale sarà  l'esito della sfida e quali conseguenze determinerà ?

tmdb.synopsis: The morning after the zombie attack, Soran returns to college. Houhou tells him that she’ll be going to the same college he is, and she asks him to show her the power he used to fight the zombies. Soran jokes around, but Houhou takes out her knife and attacks him. Soran refuses to fight back, remembering his grandfather’s words. The time to use the power that his father, Yotoku, made him practice when he was young... Then, something envelopes Soran’s body. As the two of them fight, Ro Ryou, who physically looks like a young boy, and the zombie who defiled the grave are gathered in an abandoned building somewhere. At their feet is Shakurin’s body, and a beautiful woman named Natsuka appears as well. Now, Soran has no choice but to fight, and Natsuka, Ro Ryou, and the Zombie are beginning to make their move as well. What did Shakurin leave to Soran when he died? And what will Soran do now that he remembers Shakurin’s words?

info.synopsis: Film riassuntivo della serie animata. Nella classe 3-E della scuola media Kunugigaoka vi è una strana usanza: gli alunni, tutti, danno il buongiorno al proprio insegnante cercando in massa di piazzargli un proiettile in fronte. Non stiamo però parlando di un insegnate qualunque, ma di un individuo a dir poco strano, una via di mezzo tra un alieno e un polpo, ed in grado di muoversi alla velocità di mech-20. Si scoprirà che questo “insegnante” è stato il responsabile della distruzione della luna, di cui ora resta solo uno spicchio, nonché colui che ha annunciato la fine del mondo tra un anno… Ma adesso è solo un professore in una normale scuola, di una materia un po’ insolita… ASSASSINIO!!!
info.title: Assassination Classroom The Movie: 365 Days' Time

tmdb.synopsis: Manji visits a priest in order to confess his sins, namely killing his lord and 100 of his retainers, an act that earned him the moniker "Killer of 100." The priest, who is actually a con artist, attempts to kill Manji by shooting him in the forehead, but Manji kills him and regenerates the wound. Manji returns to his home to find Yaobikuni, a nun who placed "sacred bloodworms" into Manji that make him immortal, and his sister Machi. That evening, Machi dreams of the time when Manji was forced to kill her husband, a police officer purusing Manji, causing her to lose her mind. After the dream, she wanders into the night and is captured by a group of ronin led by the brother of the priest Manji had killed. Manji pursues Machi but is unable to prevent her from being killed. In response, he kills every member of the ronin group, and upon returning to Yaobikuni, declares that he will seek redemption for the 100 men he killed by killing 1000 evil men.

tmdb.synopsis: Renji Hiiragi is dispatched by Anzelotte, his employer, to destroy a group of Emulators with the aid of fellow Night Wizard Akari Himuro. The two easily destroy the Emulators, although Renji complains that he cannot attend school due to his job. Elsewhere, Elis Shihō transfers into Kimei Private Academy, Renji's school, and joins the Astronomy Club headed by Kureha Akabane. Renji tries to return to school, but is shepherded away by Anzelotte for another mission. As he walks home in the evening, Anzelotte picks up him via helicopter for a third mission. A red moon then appears in the sky, and Elis walks entranced towards an old sakura tree at the school, and Kureha follows her. The Demon Lord Bell Zephyr sends an Emulator to kill the two, and Kureha reveals that she is a Night Wizard as well. Renji arrives as well, but the two are unable to stop the Emulator from attacking Elis, whose bracelet absorbs a jewel from the sakura tree and manifests as a group of shields. Renji dispatches the Emulator, and Renji and Kureha take Elis to Anzelotte.

info.synopsis: I Night Wizards sono maghi la cui missione è combattere le forze oscure che vogliono dominare il mondo. Renji Hiiragi è un Night Wizard che viene costantemente reclutato per delle missioni, anche se il suo unico desiderio è quello di andare a scuola e diplomarsi; il suo ultimo incarico è quello di proteggere Elis Shiho, una nuova studentessa trasferitasi nella sua accademia. Però, dopo essere entrata in possesso di uno dei sette gioielli segreti, Elis scoprirà di avere anche lei il potere di diventare un Night Wizard.
info.title: Night Wizard

tmdb.synopsis: Haruka and the others go to Samezuka Academy's Culture Festival, where Rin and the rest of the swimming club are hosting a maid café. Both the Itwatobi and Samezuka teams decide to participate in a watergun survival game across the campus, with Haruka, Sousuke, Nagisa, and Momotarou on one team and Rin, Makoto, Rei, and Aiichirou on the other. After several mishaps and plans gone astray, the match boils down to a standoff between Haruka and Rin, which Rin wins due to Haruka's affinity for water. At the end of the day, the eight of them take the time to get to know each other better.

tmdb.synopsis: Kyōsuke e i suoi amici sono in vacanza dai suoi nonni in montagna. Il nonno racconta ai ragazzi la leggenda della donna nuda sulla neve, secondo cui due innamorati non possono sciare assieme altrimenti moriranno in un tragico incidente. Hikaru chiede quindi, inconsapevolmente, a Madoka di stare lei con il suo Kyōsuke, ma mentre questi si divertono sulla pista da sci vengono travolti da una valanga e rimangono intrappolati dentro una grotta. Kyōsuke allora racconta a Madoka la storia di due innamorati finiti nella stessa grotta che ebbero una fine tragica in cui la donna cadde da un precipizio nella lava incandescente, verso le profondità della terra, poiché l'uomo le lasciò la mano. Sentendosi tradita dal suo lui, ella continuò a vivere come fantasma all'interno della grotta, spaventando e facendo morire chiunque entrasse. Quasi per coincidenza, Madoka rischia di cadere allo stesso modo, ma Kyōsuke la salva tendendole la mano. Il fantasma apparso lo istiga a mollare la presa e far cadere la ragazza, ma Kyōsuke la ignora e si getta anche lui insieme a Madoka. I due riescono a salvarsi e il fantasma, colpito dal gesto, torna buono e li ringrazia.
tmdb.title: Amore sotto zero

tmdb.synopsis: Kyōsuke risponde ad una lettera, arrivata dall'America, di Madoka e racconta l'avventura che i due hanno vissuto con Hikaru alle Hawaii una settimana prima. I ragazzi arrivano sull'isola in occasione del concerto di violino che i genitori di Madoka terranno. Mentre si trovano in spiaggia, Hikaru torna un attimo in albergo, ma visto che tarda a ritornare Kyōsuke e Madoka la vanno a cercare e scoprono che è stata rapita. Inizia così la ricerca della loro amica che troveranno grazie alle istruzioni dei rapitori che chiedono in cambio denaro: Hikaru, infatti, è stata scambiata per la figlia del presidente di una famosa ditta. Alla fine tutto si sistema, Hikaru è sana e salva e i rapitori vengono arrestati, ma tutti e tre si perdono il concerto per il quale erano andati.
tmdb.title: Avventura alle Hawaii

tmdb.synopsis: Kurumi utilizza distrattamente una corda magica del nonno e scambia l'anima di Kyōsuke con quella del loro pesce rosso, che tuttavia precipita dalla terrazza e finisce per essere venduto nei giochi della festa del paese. Qui, viene pescato per pura casualità da Madoka e Hikaru. Kurumi e Manami arrivano in suo soccorso, ma a causa di Jingoro che odia i pesci non riescono nell'intento, ma anzi l'anima del loro fratello passa da quella del pesce rosso a quella del gatto. Kyōsuke viene così nuovamente raccolto da Madoka, che lo scambia per un gatto randagio e lo porta a casa sua dove lo tratta amorevolmente. Quando egli però le salva la vita da una fuga di gas e lei per ringraziarlo gli sta per dare un piccolo bacio, la sua famiglia sta facendo un rito sacro per riportare la sua anima al suo vero corpo: in conseguenza di ciò, il ragazzo ritorna alla normalità ma bacia sua sorella Kurumi, che, arrabbiata, lo riempie di botte.
tmdb.title: Sono un pesce, sono un gatto  [ Se fossi un pesciolino ]

tmdb.synopsis: La cugina di Kyōsuke, Akane, arriva in città; come tutti i membri della famiglia Kasuga, anche lei possiede poteri magici con cui si diverte spesso a prendere le sembianze degli altri. La ragazza non fa che creare problemi a Kyōsuke, dopo aver scoperto il rapporto che lo lega sia a Hikaru che a Madoka. In particolare di quest'ultima, Akane sembra innamorarsi e fa di tutto per allontanarla da suo cugino, facendo finire entrambe nei guai con due depravati. Kyōsuke sovviene e scatena tutto il suo potere, mettendo in salvo Madoka e Akane.

Mitsuru (il cui vero nome è Kazuto) diventato Kyōsuke, intanto, passa la giornata prima con Hikaru e poi con Madoka. Alla fine Kyōsuke e Mitsuru ritornano nel proprio corpo, ma lo scambio è servito a far riavvicinare l'idol a Shori.
episodes.title: Il palcoscenico del cuore - La primavera è per gli idol!   [ Lo scambio ]

tmdb.synopsis: Kyōsuke è preoccupato che Mitsuru abbia scoperto i suoi poteri dopo lo scambio avvenuto qualche giorno prima e rischia seriamente che il suo segreto sia rivelato in diretta televisiva. La band di Shuu si iscrive ad un festival, ma la cantante Yukari si sente male e viene sostituita da Madoka. tmdb.synopsis: Kyōsuke sogna sua cugina Akane che tenta di sedurlo. Al risveglio, egli viene convinto proprio da Akane a recitare la parte del suo fidanzato alla presenza delle amiche della ragazza. Questo crea un equivoco con Hikaru che, ingannata da Akane, pensa che a Kyōsuke non gli importi più di lei. Per convincerle definitivamente che anche a lei piacciono i maschi, Akane si chiude in camera con Kyōsuke e fa intendere alle amiche che avranno un rapporto sessuale. tvdb.synopsis: With Gin's death weighing heavily on their minds, Sumi and Sonoko are forced to fight another Vertex in the middle of Gin's funeral. Wanting to cheer Sonoko up, Sumi invites her to a festival where they reaffirm their friendship. Later, Sumi and Sonoko receive fairy partners as part of a new hero system, the details of which are only told to their parents. Dragged into another battle gainst three more Vertexes, the girls take advantage of their new abilities and use the power of Mankai to defeat two of them. However, Sumi then discovers she has lost the use of her legs while Sonoko has gone blind in one eye. Despite concern over these inflictions, the girls continue to use Mankai to stop the remaining Vertex from attacking the bridge. After managing to destroy the Vertex's main body, Sonoko follows its core through a barrier, where she witnesses the previously defeated Vertex being resurrected. Sonoko further discovers that her heart has stopped beating but is somehow still alive, while Sumi no longer possesses any memory of her as a result of her second Mankai. Realising that she is no longer capable of dying, Sonoko undergoes Mankai countless more times to protect Sumi from the ressurecting Vertex. Some time later, Sumi, now going under her original name of Mimori Togo, moves into a new home and is befriended by her new neighbor, Yuna Yuki.
tvdb.title: Washio Sumi's Chapter Movie 3 - Promise

tvdb.synopsis: Half a year has passed. Arriving in the Iron Fortress, Ikoma and Mumei set foot in Unato: another ravaged zone that fell into the grip of the deadly Kabane. In this war-torn zone, the group fends off more dangerous Kabane that are attacking with patterns they had never seen before. The Iron Fortress crew eventually meet up with a survival group which requests their aid in reclaiming the zone. The newly forged alliance ventures deeper into the area of the castle and investigates the peculiar case of these new Kabane. But their search for answers unearths truths that are far more horrifying than they imagined. Forced to confront the reality behind the Kabane, Ikoma, Mumei, and their allies come to realize the despair buried within Unato. The movie is a continuation of the story from the original series that takes place half a year later.

info.synopsis: Il giovane Tanjirou carica ogni giorno sulle spalle una cesta piena di carbone e con questa scende verso i villaggi intorno casa. Dedica le giornate al commercio, lo fa con il cuore sereno, sapendo che in questo modo aiuta la propria famiglia. Una sera Tanjirou dorme fuori di casa. Gli anziani del villaggio hanno provato a trattenerlo: guai ad avventurarsi per i boschi di notte, il rischio è quello di divenire preda dei feroci demoni. Quando il mattino seguente il giovane fa ritorno a casa, trova una scena raccapricciante. Capirà attraverso la sofferenza che non tutte le leggende sono fantasia e che la gentilezza può tramutarsi in forza - per combattere i demoni e proteggere la sorellina Nezuko.
info.title: Demon Slayer (ITA)

tmdb.synopsis: 交通事故でママを亡くした拓也は、忙しいパパの代わりに幼い弟・実の面倒を見る毎日。おかげで友達と遊ぶ事さえ出来ない。次第に戸惑いとイラだちを募らせていく拓也。そんなある日、パパを駅まで迎えにいく道々、「このまま実がいなくなったら・・・」などと考え事をしていた拓也は、本当に実を何処かに置き去りにしてしまったことに気づく。

info.synopsis:
Dopo la morte della madre, è il piccolo Toshio, nonostante la sua giovane età, ad essere la “seconda mamma” del fratellino minore Midori, dando il più possibile una mano al padre in questo difficile compito.
I due fratellini sono molto legati e anche se a volte Toshio si rende conto che il compito di crescere un bambino di due anni non è affatto semplice per lui che dopotutto è ancora un bambino, cerca in tutti i modi di mantenere la promessa che aveva fatto alla madre di prendersi cura del fratellino in ogni situazione.
Toshio, nonostante gli avvenimenti della vita lo abbiano costretto a crescere in fretta, resta comunque un bambino vivace e allegro, a cui piace giocare con i suoi migliori amici Gon e Akihiro, che hanno a loro volta due sorelline minori (Nako e Ichika) e ai quali chiede consiglio nei momenti di sconforto.
info.title: Akachan to boku (ITA)

info.synopsis:
Goro Honda è un bambino di 5 anni, orfano di madre, con un'innata passione per il baseball. Suo padre Shigeharu è un lanciatore professionista per la squadra degli Yokohama Blue Oceans, ma non è mai riuscito a sfondare nella Lega Maggiore. Dopo un infortunio, Shigeharu è costretto a lasciare il monte per reinventarsi battitore di grande livello. Ma dall’America arriva il talentuoso lanciatore Gibson…
Il profondo legame tra padre e figlio; l’amore per uno sport, il baseball, che spingerà entrambi a dare sempre il massimo in campo; un evento inatteso e sconvolgente; tutto questo è solo un assaggio della prima stagione di Major.

tmdb.synopsis: Miyu Kōzuki's parents had moved to the United States to work for NASA. Miyu has been told she is to live with her parents' old friend. She arrives, and it turns out to be a Buddhist temple. She meets her parents' friend, the temple monk, Hoshou Saionji, and his teenaged son, Kanata. The monk soon leaves for India for religious training, leaving Miyu behind with Kanata. Shortly after, a UFO flies into the house, and inside were an alien baby called Ruu and a "sitter-pet" called Wanya. They all then decide to live in the temple together. Kanata peeps at Miyu while she's showering, just as Miyu has seen him changing.
tmdb.title: Il piccolo alieno

info.synopsis:
In seguito alla partenza dei suoi genitori per l’America, a causa di un progetto della NASA, Miyu Kozuki viene ospitata a casa di un amico di famiglia, il signor Saionji, che presto parte per l’India per un pellegrinaggio e lascia la ragazza da sola insieme al figlio, Kanata.
La vita dei due ragazzi, coetanei, viene sconvolta dall’arrivo di un neonato alieno, Lou, giunto sulla Terra dal pianeta Otto a causa di una distorsione spazio-temporale insieme al suo alien-sitter BauMiao. In attesa che BauMiao riesca a riparare l’astronave per tornare a casa, Miyu e Kanata accettano di ospitarli, affezionandosi molto a Lou, che crede siano i suoi genitori. La convivenza, però, darà luogo a situazioni comiche e imbarazzanti.
info.title: UFO Baby (ITA)

series.title: 思い、思われ、ふり、ふられ

info.synopsis: La storia ruota attorno a Yuna e Akari, due ragazze che in amore hanno idee completamente differenti: la prima, che non lo ancora sperimentato, lo vede come un sogno; mentre Akari ne ha una visione molto più realistica, dovuta a precedenti delusioni. Abbiamo poi Kazoumi, ragazzo svampito che non comprende nemmeno il concetto di amore e Rio che accetta la corte di qualunque ragazza, purché sia carina, perché non può avere quella che gli interessa realmente.
info.title: Love Me, Love Me Not

tmdb.synopsis: Will was born in the city of the dead, where he was raised by three undead. Although he was nurtured with love, Will questions his existence in this life-forbidding place where he is the only human alive. He discovers his three parents are secretly hiding something that may explain this mystery, and as if this weren't puzzling enough, he has yet to discover that still more secrets lie within him.
tmdb.title: Il ragazzo nella città dei morti

Un giorno, Blood gli affida una missione per fuggire dalle rovine della città. Will cerca disperatamente di lottare per uscire, ma una strana sensazione di malizia lo ferma. info.synopsis: In seguito alla terza guerra mondiale avvenuta nel 1231, alcuni governanti decisero di costruire Olympus, una la città perfetta governata dai biodroidi, uomini artificiali migliorati, e da un computer centrale di nome Gaia. L'obiettivo è quello di garantire la protezione degli esseri umani, ma questi ultimi faticano ad adeguarsi a questa perfezione ed alcuni di essi formano un movimento terroristico per distruggere Olympus. In questo scenario si muovono Deunan e Briareos, due agenti delle forze speciali SWAT, impegnati nella lotta contro i terroristi, seppur tra mille dubbi ed esitazioni.
info.title: Appleseed (Movie)

info.synopsis: C'erano una volta i fratelli Jacob e Wilhelm che raccoglievano fiabe da tutto il paese per racchiuderle in un libro. Adoravano anche la loro sorellina, l'innocente e curiosa Charlotte, a cui tenevano moltissimo. Un giorno, mentre i fratelli raccontavano a Charlotte una storia come al solito, videro un'espressione malinconica sul suo viso. La ragazza chiese: "Che cosa gli accadde in seguito? Vissero tutti felici e contenti, giusto?". Le pagine delle fiabe dei fratelli Grimm, scritte da Jacob e Wilhem, sono ora presentate dalla prospettiva unica di Charlotte che vede le storie in maniera molto diversa rispetto i suoi fratelli.
info.title: The Grimm Variations

After a successful air attack, the allied ground forces suffer a startling defeat, leading the Japanese company to reveal the secret of the Tactical Armor systems. It seems these units may have been responsible for the U.N. defeat at the hands of the Belgistanians.

tmdb.synopsis: The TA units arrived in Belgistan whereupon they are ordered to capture Shrine Hill, the location where the Belgistanians allegedly detonated their weapon of mass destruction. Surprising both the multinational forces and the TA unit, researchers from the Gowa Corporation arrive and confirm that Shrine Hill is virtually identical to Stage of Stone on which Yushiro performed his initial dance. This fact is confirmed when Yushiro enters a trance mode, leaves his TA and begins to perform the Gasara dance on Shrine Hill. Undeniably, a connection exists between Belgistan's release of power and the Gasara dance.

tmdb.synopsis: Amid evidence that the Japanese government is involved in some sort of cover-up regarding the TAs, Yushiro's elder brother Kazukiyo Gowa meets with Hiraku Nishida, an elderly, blind warrior who wishes to unleash selective violence against the Japanese people in order to strengthen Japan against growing opportunism and selfishness. At the Gowa laboratory the plot takes a startling twist when Miharu breaks into the Gowa headquarters to retrieve the missing components taken by the Japanese TAs in Belgistan. As she exits the plant, Miharu reveals to Yushiro the startling secret she has uncovered during the raid - the Gowa family refers to Yushiro as ""the test subject"" and that the real Yushiro Gowa has been deceased for years. As the episode ends, Yushiro's entire existence is mired in uncertainty.

tmdb.synopsis: In an attempt to understand the information Miharu has imparted to him, Yushiro returns to his family home to confront his parents. At his ancestral home, Yushiro meets with his instructor, Sorachi, who leads Yushiro into an abandoned storehouse. There Yushiro discovers the cryogenically preserved body of Sorochi's son Ku-ya as well as a body that is probably his, along with the slouched form of a formidably-advanced robot, known as the Kugai. Meanwhile, Yushiro's sister, Misuzu, and Ataka, one of the female TA pilots, have followed Yushiro to the site, where they are surprised by the sudden appearance of Miharu and another of the symbol weapons platforms, known as Ishtars.

tmdb.synopsis: Sensing the proximity of Miharu and the other Symbol Ishtar (known colloquially as Fakes), Yushiro instinctively begins to perform the Gasara Dance. Before long, the stomach of the abandoned robot, known as the Kugai, opens up and takes in Yushiro as a pilot. The robot, adorned like an ancient Japanese samurai, battles and defeats the intruding weapons platforms and captures Miharu. When Yushiro leaves the Kugai, his master, Sorochi, informs him that Yushiro is a kai, a man with the special talent required to control the Kugai, and that the Kugai itself is a gift from Gasaraki. Sorochi says Yushiro must travel to Kyoto with Miharu in order to find out more.

tmdb.synopsis: Freed from the Gowa compound by Daizaburo, Yushiro and Miharu resume their interrupted quest to discover the secret of their mystical kai abilities. Meanwhile, Nishida and Kuzukiyo Gowa plan a military coup that will simultaneously rid Japan of its immigrants and its avarice. In the process Nishida reveals the history of the Kugutsu, individuals who have received special talents from the lost god Gasaraki. These powers allow the Kugutsu, whose members are known as ""kai"", to operate the Kugai (plural), organic killing machines that function much like giant robots of the near future.

tmdb.synopsis: Yushiro and Miharu follow the long-lost Path of the Kai to the threshold of Kyoto, home to the lost secrets of Yushiro and Miharu's past. Upon touching the threshold, the two young kais are given a glimpse of Japan in the Heian period, around 1,000 A.D.. The story tells of a disagreement in the Watanabe clan, the last protectors of the secret of Gasaraki. This disagreement leads to the accession of warlord Tsuna Watanabe who intends to use his clan's kai, Yushiro and Miharu, to reassert its power in the face of centralizing imperial power.

Upon touching the threshold, the two young kais are given a glimpse of Japan in the Heian period, around 1,000 A.D.. The story tells of a disagreement in the Watanabe clan, the last protectors of the secret of Gasaraki. This disagreement leads to the accession of warlord Tsuna Watanabe who intends to use his clan's kai, Yushiro and Miharu, to reassert its power in the face of centralizing imperial power.

Tsuna Watanabe leads his clan and his Kugai into battle against the Imperial forces as the two young kais realize they are the tools of those around them. The evil regent Einyo manipulates Tsuna into unleashing the full power of the Kugai. The willpower of Yushiro and Miharu bring an end to the impending terror, which leads to the defeat Einyo and the death of Tsuna. The new leaders of the Watanabe clan agree to bury the secrets of the Kugai and retreat back into the mists of time. In the present, Yushiro and Miharu gain a greater understanding of their place in the continuing legacy of the kai.

info.synopsis: Nell'immediato futuro, una forma di vita poco compresa nota come "Mile One" permette ad una ricca e potente famiglia giapponese, i Gowa, di produrre un'arma bipede che definiscono Tactical Armor (TA). Nello stesso periodo scoppia una guerra tra gli Stati Uniti e la fittizia nazione del Medio Oriente del Belgistan, simile alla guerra del golfo. Quando le forze militari degli Stati Uniti provano a conquistare la capitale, vengono sistematicamente spazzate via da quelle che sembrano TA nemiche. La famiglia Gowa coglie l'occasione per mettere alla prova la sua arma, e il pilota civile Yuushiro Gowa, insieme alla squadra a cui viene aggiunto, viene mandato in Belgistan. Qui incontra il pilota rivale Miharu, con cui sembra avere un profondo legame spirituale.
info.title: Gasaraki

info.synopsis: La storia racconta le vicende di Gai, il giovane apprendista del fabbro Amon. Quest'ultimo ha adottato il protagonista quando era appena nato, dopo averlo trovato vicino al cadavere di una donna nella foresta. Durante il suo apprendistato, tuttavia, Gai perde il suo braccio destro e per aiutarlo Amon decide di fondere la spada demoniaca Shiryuu (letteralmente Drago della morte) e di trasformarla in un arto artificiale che possa rimpiazzare quello mancante del figlio. Da qui la vicenda ha inizio: grazie alla nuova spada fusa al suo corpo, ora Gai sarà  in grado di sconfiggere tutti i nemici che incontrerà  sulla sua strada.

Himari and the others look at the records of their previous live performances to try to get to the bottom of the mystery.

Tsumugi asks what she should do to give a live performance that is as sparkling and cute as Princess Ring. Princess Ring decides to conduct a secret test to see if Tsumugi's feelings are genuine. Dressed in her school uniform, Tsumugi arrives at Paradise Academy, an Ai-Priverse school created by Princess Ring. What exactly is the content of the test...?

While Himari and the others are taking their respective tests, Mitsuki meets her younger self...

After hearing Yakumo's dream of attending Dream Star Academy after graduation, Ichika declares that she will also go to the same school. episodes.synopsis: アイプリグラムの『アイプリスマホ占い』にハマっているひまり。すると、クラスメイトの如月いちかが声をかけてくる。いちかも大の占い好きなのだ。そんな彼女は、みつきに聞きたいことがあると言う。なんと、占いで八雲が『運命の人』と出たらしい。卒業したら『ドリームスター学園』に進学したいという八雲の夢を聞いたいちかは、自分も同じ学校に行くと宣言。だが幼なじみのなぎさは、勉強が苦手ないちかが心配。ずっと一緒にいたいと思っていたなぎさは、みつきとひまりに相談するのだが……。
episodes.title: Episodio 29

tmdb.synopsis: じゅりあとえるはハロウィンの実行委員になり、楽しいパーティーを企画。つむぎはパラダイス学園で開かれるハロウィンパーティーにリング姫を誘う。「楽しそう」と思ったとき、リング姫はプリこーんのぬいぐるみとなり、パラダイス学園へ。おかし交換やお化けの仮装など、プリこーんとしてハロウィンパーティーを見て回るリング姫。そんな中、実行委員だったじゅりあとえるがケンカしているのを見てしまう。えるはプリこーんに、じゅりあへの素直な気持ちを語る。そこにやってきたじゅりあに向かって、素直な想いをぶつけるえる。ちゃんと仲直りできた二人は、そのままアイプリライブをする。その後、宮殿に帰ってきたリング姫。ラブジュリエルへのライブリクエストは、実はリング姫からのものだったのだ。リング姫の楽しそうな顔を初めて見て、驚くつむぎだった。
tmdb.title: Episodio 30

tvdb.synopsis: Juria and Elle become Halloween executive committee members and plan a fun party. Tsumugi invites Princess Ring to the Halloween party being held at Paradise Academy. When she thinks it sounds fun, Princess Ring turns into a Pricon stuffed animal and heads to Paradise Academy. Princess Ring goes around the Halloween party as Pricon, exchanging sweets and dressing up as ghosts. Meanwhile, she sees Juria and El, who are also on the executive committee, fighting...
tvdb.title: Princess Ring Clover and the Secret Halloween

episodes.synopsis: じゅりあとえるはハロウィンの実行委員になり、楽しいパーティーを企画。つむぎはパラダイス学園で開かれるハロウィンパーティーにリング姫を誘う。「楽しそう」と思ったとき、リング姫はプリこーんのぬいぐるみとなり、パラダイス学園へ。おかし交換やお化けの仮装など、プリこーんとしてハロウィンパーティーを見て回るリング姫。そんな中、実行委員だったじゅりあとえるがケンカしているのを見てしまう。えるはプリこーんに、じゅりあへの素直な気持ちを語る。そこにやってきたじゅりあに向かって、素直な想いをぶつけるえる。ちゃんと仲直りできた二人は、そのままアイプリライブをする。その後、宮殿に帰ってきたリング姫。ラブジュリエルへのライブリクエストは、実はリング姫からのものだったのだ。リング姫の楽しそうな顔を初めて見て、驚くつむぎだった。
episodes.title: Episodio 30

tmdb.synopsis: つむぎは、リング姫の元を訪れる。まだまだ知らないことがたくさんあると言うリング姫。つむぎはそんな彼女に「いろんなことを教えてあげる」と言い、次の日のお昼に会う約束をした。つむぎはもっといろんなことを勉強するため、ムギちゃんの姿でパラダイス学園の図書室に行く。リング姫にもっとたくさんのことを教えてあげたいと張り切るつむぎ。しかし本に夢中になるあまり、リング姫との約束を忘れてしまう。約束を破ってしまったつむぎは、リング姫の元に謝りに行く。しかし、会ってもらえないつむぎは、プリンセスの姿になり、自分の思いをライブに乗せて届けようとする。フラワーバズリウムチェンジを達成し、第4回アイプリコンテストの出場も決めたつむぎ。だが、その歌声はどこか切なかった……。一方のリング姫も、つむぎの思いにどう答えれば良いか分からず、ひとり悩んでいた。
tmdb.title: Episodio 31

tvdb.synopsis: Tsumugi visits Princess Ring. Princess Ring says there is still a lot she doesn't know. Tsumugi tells her she will teach her many things and they make a promise to meet the next day at lunchtime. In order to learn more, Tsumugi goes to the Paradise Academy library disguised as Mugi-chan. Tsumugi is excited to teach Princess Ring even more. However, she becomes so engrossed in the book that she forgets her promise to Princess Ring...
tvdb.title: Tsumugi and Ring

episodes.title: Episodio 31

tmdb.synopsis: 仲直りしようと、たくさんのプレゼントを手にリング姫の元を訪れたつむぎ。しかしリング姫は、つむぎを帰らせてしまう。一人ひみつの庭にいるリング姫の元に、みつきがやってくる。「羽のついた指輪」と「星の形をしたキャンディ」を交換した相手が、幼い頃のみつきであったことを思い出すリング姫。ひみつの庭にいる彼女は、リング姫の過去の記憶であった。記憶の彼女はみつきに、アイプリバースにいるリング姫に「五つの心」を取り戻してやって欲しいと頼む。戻ったみつきは、リング姫とつむぎに「勇気」を届けようと、ひまりとライブをする。リング姫に謝り、大好きな気持ちを届けるつむぎ。リング姫もつむぎに謝り、「おともだちになってほしい」と言う。仲直りした二人はデュオを結成。フラワーバズリウムチェンジを達成し、見事、第4回アイプリコンテストの出場を決めるのだった。
tmdb.title: Episodio 32

tvdb.synopsis: Princess Ring is worried because she has not been able to make up with Tsumugi. Tsumugi, who is also worried, visits Chii. After hearing about how to make up, Tsumugi heads out. Meanwhile, Princess Ring has not filled up her ring gauge and cannot participate in the 4th AiPri Contest. The reason for this is that Princess Ring has no one to whom she wants to convey her feelings, in other words, no friends. Tsumugi comes to Princess Ring with many presents. However, Princess Ring sends Tsumugi home without accepting any. Princess Ring is alone in the secret garden when Mitsuki comes to her...
tvdb.title: The Lonely Princess

episodes.title: Episodio 32

tmdb.synopsis: いよいよ第4回アイプリコンテストが開幕。出場するのは、ひまりとみつきのデュオ・ポッピンドリーミンと、リング姫とつむぎのデュオ。つむぎは、ひまりとみつきに「おともだちだけど今回はライバル」と言い放つ。その後、つむぎはリング姫とのデュオに「光り輝く花」という意味の『ルミナスフローラ』と名付ける。そして、たくさんの人が見守る中、いよいよ始まるコンテスト。どちらのデュオも素晴らしいライブを披露する。だが、優勝に輝いたのはルミナスフローラだった。そう思われた矢先、リング姫がまさかのダブル優勝を宣言する。かくして第4回アイプリコンテストの優勝は、ルミナスフローラとポッピンドリーミンの二組となったのだった。
tmdb.title: Episodio 33

tvdb.synopsis: The 4th AiPri Contest is about to begin. The participants are the duo Poppin' Dreamin' who consist of Himari Aozora and Mitsuki Hoshikawa, and Luminous Flora who consist of Tsumugi Suzukaze and Ring Clover. Tsumugi declares, "We're friends, but this time we're rivals."
tvdb.title: A Blooming AiPri Contest

episodes.synopsis: いよいよ第4回アイプリコンテストが開幕。出場するのは、ひまりとみつきのデュオ・ポッピンドリーミンと、リング姫とつむぎのデュオ。つむぎは、ひまりとみつきに「おともだちだけど今回はライバル」と言い放つ。その後、つむぎはリング姫とのデュオに「光り輝く花」という意味の『ルミナスフローラ』と名付ける。そして、たくさんの人が見守る中、いよいよ始まるコンテスト。どちらのデュオも素晴らしいライブを披露する。だが、優勝に輝いたのはルミナスフローラだった。そう思われた矢先、リング姫がまさかのダブル優勝を宣言する。かくして第4回アイプリコンテストの優勝は、ルミナスフローラとポッピンドリーミンの二組となったのだった。
episodes.title: Episodio 33

tmdb.synopsis: お披露目ライブに向けて、ひまりもみつきもやる気じゅうぶん。最初のライブはルミナスフローラから。リング姫とつむぎは、誰もが見惚れるような圧巻のライブを披露する。そのすごさを目の当たりにしたみつきとひまりはなんと、お披露目ライブを辞退すると言い出した。ルミナスフローラのライブを見て、二人は大切なことに気づかされたのだ。それは、自分たちの弱さを認めること。いつかリング姫とつむぎと肩を並べて歌えると思った時に、一緒にライブをしようと誓うみつきとひまり。そんな二人に、エターナルフラワーコーデからのリクエストが届いた。それを受けたみつきとひまりは気持ちを新たに、再出発のライブをする。その後、第5回アイプリコンテストのテーマが発表される。テーマは『メロディバズリウムチェンジ』。アイプリたちは大集合し、みんな、エターナルアイプリになることを決意…
tmdb.title: Episodio 34

tvdb.synopsis: It's time for the 4th Aipri Contest debut live performance. The first live performance was by Luminous Flora. After witnessing their amazing performance, Mitsuki and Himari make a decision. The two of them decide to withdraw from the debut live performance. What are Mitsuki and Himari thinking...?
tvdb.title: Our Courage

episodes.synopsis: お披露目ライブに向けて、ひまりもみつきもやる気じゅうぶん。最初のライブはルミナスフローラから。リング姫とつむぎは、誰もが見惚れるような圧巻のライブを披露する。そのすごさを目の当たりにしたみつきとひまりはなんと、お披露目ライブを辞退すると言い出した。ルミナスフローラのライブを見て、二人は大切なことに気づかされたのだ。それは、自分たちの弱さを認めること。いつかリング姫とつむぎと肩を並べて歌えると思った時に、一緒にライブをしようと誓うみつきとひまり。そんな二人に、エターナルフラワーコーデからのリクエストが届いた。それを受けたみつきとひまりは気持ちを新たに、再出発のライブをする。その後、第5回アイプリコンテストのテーマが発表される。テーマは『メロディバズリウムチェンジ』。アイプリたちは大集合し、みんな、エターナルアイプリになることを決意…
episodes.title: Episodio 34

tmdb.synopsis: パラダイス学園にサクラ、タマキ、アイリ、リンリンの四人が帰ってきた！しかし、どこか様子がおかしい。つむぎは言う。四人に「ダークカルテットスター」の匂いを感じると。だが、それは四人が仕掛けたドッキリだった。その後、サクラたちはリング姫に会うため、アイプリバースへ。リング姫にデュエル・オーディションを申し込む。それを受けたリング姫は、ルミナスフローラとしてライブを披露。対するカルテットスターは、なんといきなりメロディバズリウムチェンジを達成して見せた。サクラはリング姫に尋ねる。かつて五つのバズリウムチェンジを成功させ、『プリンセスの奇跡』を起こしたのはあなたなのか、と。覚えていない……そう答えるリング姫。アイプリコンテストとは、リング姫の五つの心を取り戻すために開かれたものだったことが判明。カルテットスターは、次のコンテストで優勝し…
tmdb.title: Episodio 35

tvdb.synopsis: Sakura, Tamaki, Airi, and Rinrin have returned to Paradise Academy! However, something seems strange. Everyone exudes a sharp, stern aura. Tsumugi says that she senses the scent of a "Dark Quartet Star" among the four Quartet Stars. Mitsuki tries to find out the truth about what happened to Sakura and the others. Have Sakura and the other four really become Dark Quartet Stars...?
tvdb.title: The Return of Quartet Star

episodes.title: Episodio 35

tmdb.synopsis: 今日は進路を相談する三者面談の日。ひまりの将来の夢は、『アイプリをがんばって、おともだちを笑顔にする』こと。『留学して歌の勉強をする』というみつきの夢に対して、ひまりの夢はまだぼんやりとしている。いつかみつきとのお別れが来ることをさびしく思っているひまり。そんなひまりに、ママは今までひみつにしていた自分の気持ちを明かす。「『おともだちを笑顔にしたい』という気持ちがあれば、いつか絶対に自分の進む道も見つかる。何があっても、ママは信じてる。ひまりのこと、ずーっと見てるからね。」その言葉を聞いたひまりは、張り切ってみつきとのライブに臨む。みつきもまた、留学のことをカルテットスター四人に相談し、応援の言葉をもらう。周りから「信じてもらえている」と強く感じたひまりとみつきは、将来に向け、思いを新たにするのだった。
tmdb.title: Episodio 36

tvdb.synopsis: It's the day of the three-way meeting to discuss their future paths. While Mitsuki's dream is to study abroad and study singing, Himari's dreams are still vague. Then, Himari's mother reveals her feelings to her.
tvdb.title: Himari's Mom's Secret

tmdb.synopsis: 三者面談の日、サクラから「羽ばたきたい気持ちがあるのなら、できるだけ早いほうがいい」と言われていたみつき。留学を早めたほうが良いのか悩んでいる。そして、もうすぐクリスマス。パラダイス学園はその準備で、みんな楽しそう。そんな中、みつきは思い出していた。昔、クリスマスの頃に一人のアイプリと出会っていたことを。みつきはそのアイプリと、星の形をしたキャンディと羽のついた指輪を交換した。そのアイプリの名前はリング・クローバー。その正体は、今もよく知るわこ先生だった。だが、わこ先生は事故により、過去の記憶を失っていた。そして更科先生は、妹のわこ先生が記憶を取り戻した時、アイプリブレスを渡そうと思っていた。一方、ひまりたちはクリスマス直前スペシャルライブでプリトモたちを盛り上げる。来年のクリスマスは一緒にいられないかもしれない。そう思いながら…
tmdb.title: Episodio 37

tvdb.synopsis: On the day of their parent-teacher conference, Sakura told Mitsuki, "If you have the desire to spread your wings, it's better to do it as soon as possible." Mitsuki is wondering if it would be better to speed up her study abroad. Christmas is just around the corner. Everyone at Paradise Academy seems to be having fun preparing for Christmas. Meanwhile, Mitsuki is remembering something. She once met an AiPri around Christmas time. Mitsuki exchanged star-shaped candy and a winged ring with that AiPri. That AiPri's name was Ring Clover. But even now, she knows her true identity well...
tvdb.title: The Secret of the Ring

tmdb.synopsis: 今日は特別企画、アイプリのみんなで『クリスマス・ウィンターフェス』をお届け！ジャンピンロケット、カルテットスター、ビビアンチィのライブにつづいて、じゅりあ、える、すばる、みつきのソロライブも披露。最高潮の盛り上がりを見せる中、そこにリング姫も登場。楽しそうなイベントがうらやましかったようだ。そんなリング姫も加わり、ウィンターフェスは後半戦へ。プリトモたちの熱は、さらに高まっていく！
tmdb.title: Episodio 38

tvdb.synopsis: Today we have a special project, bringing you a "Christmas Winter Festival" with everyone from Aipri! Following live performances by Jumpin' Rocket, Quartet Star, and Vivi & Chii, Julia, Elle, Subaru, and Mitsuki also performed solo live shows. As the excitement reached its climax, Princess Ring also appeared. It seemed she was envious of the fun-looking event. With Princess Ring joining in, the Winter Festival moved into the second half. The excitement of the Pritomo members is rising even more!
tvdb.title: A Fun Winter Festival

episodes.synopsis: 今日は特別企画、アイプリのみんなで『クリスマス・ウィンターフェス』をお届け！ジャンピンロケット、カルテットスター、ビビアンチィのライブにつづいて、じゅりあ、える、すばる、みつきのソロライブも披露。最高潮の盛り上がりを見せる中、そこにリング姫も登場。楽しそうなイベントがうらやましかったようだ。そんなリング姫も加わり、ウィンターフェスは後半戦へ。プリトモたちの熱は、さらに高まっていく！
episodes.title: Episodio 38

tmdb.synopsis: 有名な歌のプロデューサーから、プロモーションビデオを送って欲しいと頼まれたみつき。それを聞いたひまりは、自分が監督になりプロモーションビデオを作ると宣言。つむぎ、ひなた、八雲、ひいろにも協力してもらい、いざ撮影スタート。寒空の下、なんとか撮影は終了する。みんなを集めてお披露目会をするはずが、ひまりが操作を間違ってしまい、撮影した映像は消えてしまった。撮り直そうとするも、みつきが熱を出してしまい……。どうする、ひまり⁉
tmdb.title: Episodio 39

tvdb.synopsis: Mitsuki is asked by a famous song producer to send a promotional video. Upon hearing this, Himari declares that she will be the director and make the promotional video. With the help of Tsumugi, Hinata, Yakumo, and Hiiro, they begin filming. Under the cold sky, they somehow manage to finish filming. They were supposed to gather everyone together for a unveiling party, but Himari made a mistake in the controls and the filmed footage was lost. They try to re-shoot it, but Mitsuki ends up with a fever... What will Himari do?
tvdb.title: Lots of Mitsuki-chan

tmdb.synopsis: もうすぐ第５回アイプリコンテスト。出場して、アイプリバースのひみつも解き明かすと意気込むサクラたち。アイリは、コンテストに向けて勝負をかける新曲が必要だと考えていた。次のライブまでに新曲を完成させると豪語するアイリ。アイプリたちに取材をし、新曲のイメージを膨らませていく。その後、みつきと話す中で「ライブをするだけではなく、ライブそのものも作ってみたい」という自身の夢を再認識するアイリ。しかし、未だ新曲が出来ないプレッシャーに悩んでいた。果たして、カルテットスターの新曲は完成するのだろうか？
tmdb.title: Episodio 40

tvdb.synopsis: The 5th Aipri Contest is coming up soon. Sakura and the others are excited to enter and uncover the secrets of the Aipriverse. Airi has decided that she needs a new song to put her all on the line for the contest. Airi boasts that she will have the new song completed by the next live performance. She interviews the Aipri and the others and expands on the image of the new song. Later, while talking with Mitsuki, Airi reaffirms her dream of "not just performing a live performance, but creating the live performance itself." However, she is troubled by the pressure of not being able to write a new song yet. Will Quartet Star be able to complete their new song?
tvdb.title: Legendary Story!!!!

tmdb.synopsis: もうすぐ第５回アイプリコンテスト。みつきは、ひまりに「コンテストが終わったら春から留学、ひまりと一緒にいられるのは、あと３ヶ月」だと、話そうと決意していた。そして、いよいよコンテスト当日。ステージに立つのは、ポッピンドリーミンとカルテットスター。みつきは、コンテストが終わったら話したいことがあると、ひまりに言う。ひまりも、バレンタインデーに、みつきとデートがしたいとお願い。もうすぐみつきがいなくなると感じながらも、ひまりはコンテストに挑む。

tvdb.synopsis: The 5th Aipri Contest is coming up soon. Mitsuki has decided to tell Himari that after the contest she will be studying abroad in the spring, and that she only has three more months to be with her. And finally, the day of the contest arrives. Poppin' Dreamin' and Quartet Star will be on stage. Mitsuki tells Himari that there is something she wants to talk to her about after the contest is over. Himari also asks Mitsuki for a date on Valentine's Day. Even though she senses that Mitsuki will soon be gone, Himari takes on the challenge of the contest.
tvdb.title: A Heartfelt Aipri Contest

tmdb.synopsis: 第５回アイプリコンテストが終わって３日。ひまりはみつきと同室の部屋を空け、じゅりあとえるの部屋にお泊りしていた。みつきと顔を合わせるのが、さびしくて、つらいのだ。ひまりが部屋からいなくなり、心配するみつき。そんな中、わこ先生から“ある言葉”をもらったみつきは、ひまりに「あと３ヶ月でお別れ」だと、ちゃんと言おうと決意する。しかし、聞きたくないひまりは、みつきから逃げるようになり……。

tvdb.synopsis: Three days have passed since the 5th Aipri Contest. Himari has vacated her room with Mitsuki and is staying in Juria and Ellu's room. It's lonely and painful to see Mitsuki. Mitsuki becomes worried when Himari disappears from her room. Meanwhile, after receiving "certain words" from teacher Wako, Mitsuki decides to tell Himari that "we'll be saying goodbye in three months." However, Himari doesn't want to hear them and starts running away from Mitsuki...
tvdb.title: Because I Love You

tvdb.synopsis: Valentine's Day is approaching, and six groups -Poppin Dreamin, Quartet Star, Vivi & Chii, Jumping Rocket, Love JurieL and Luminous Flora - are announced to be competing in the Final AiPri Contest. Himari and Mitsuki are preparing for their promised date. At that time, the two receive an invitation to a Valentine's Day party from Princess Ring. Princess Ring thanks the six groups of AiPri, saying, "I feel so happy that all the Buzzrium Changes are here." Subaru tells Princess Ring that he has prepared a special live performance for Valentine's Day. Wako-sensei is looking forward to the performance, but...
tvdb.title: The Secret Valentine's Day

However, at the same time, Princess Ring lost all of her memories. The true identity of Princess Ring was none other than Ms. Wako Sarashina. And in the "Secret Garden," Ms. Wako reunited with Princess Ring, who was herself...

Chi, the representative of the current students, has a surprise in store for Sakura, Tamaki, Airi, Rinrin, and the other third-year students who are graduating. It is a live performance by Mitsuki and Himari, who have become Princess AiPri. The two sing with heartfelt gratitude.

After their final performance, Himari declares to Mitsuki her dream: to become "a sparkling, glittering, star-like Eternal AiPri, even more amazing than Eternal AiPri." They intended to say goodbye with smiles, but tears well up in both Himari and Mitsuki's eyes. They promise to fulfill each other's dreams, and Mitsuki sets off with a smile. Then the seasons change, and it's summer—and Himari, separated from Mitsuki, is left...

tmdb.synopsis: Yuuichiro is planning to attend a party held by the Keepers. He was once friends with the leader, but believed that Vesper was the key to the future. However, he goes to the party with the intention of killing them. He prepares a battle plan with Slash. He brings his locket, and as the discussion heats up, Slash is summoned in full battle mode. Slash tears up everyone and everything in the place. However, due to the excess forces of the Keepers, Yuuichiro pays the ultimate price, but the Keepers seem to have been stopped. Meanwhile, Mahoro and Suguru escape to Bolivia. However, they are followed by Feldrance. Suguru is told to run to the nearest city, and Mahoro and Feldrance fight. As Feldrance's strength is continually increasing, Mahoro's is decreasing. So, she is forced to use her ultimate weapon, resulting in a double-KO.

tmdb.synopsis: After Mahoro's final departure, the years go by for Suguru. He joins VESPER and becomes an assassin with attributes greater than any android they have ever had. He has one purpose, to hunt down and kill all Androids, especially those affiliated with the Keepers. Although that group is history, there are still some loyal to it, and Suguru disposes of them. One day, after getting quite drunk, he ends up meeting a girl who looks like Mahoro, and it turns out to really be Mahoro, as SAINT's technology, and Matthew's will has recreated her, even though it took 20 years to do so. She finally finds him, and convinces him to finally go back to Tokyo.

info.synopsis: Corre l'anno 1996 e l'umanità è talmente progredita da viaggiare sulla Luna e su Marte e stabilirvi insediamenti. Tuttavia, la Guerra Fredda è ancora in corso, con tensioni sempre crescenti tra gli Stati Uniti d'America e l'Unione Sovietica, e la minaccia di una guerra nucleare incombe sempre all'orizzonte. Presto una minaccia sconosciuta si abbatte però sull'umanità: su Marte, i membri di un programma di scambio culturale finanziato dalle Nazioni Unite per promuovere la pace e il dialogo tra le nazioni si ritrovano intrappolati in un fuoco incrociato tra tre misteriosi robot umanoidi che uccidono quasi tutti gli studenti. Solo pochissimi sopravvivono, ma si ritrovano isolati su un pianeta ormai inospitale dopo la battaglia. E, come se non bastasse, il pilota di un quarto robot, che da tempo cerca di non coinvolgere i civili nella battaglia, si presenta ai sopravvissuti come Albatro Null Eiji Asuka, dicendo loro che la Terra è stata presa di mira dal lontano impero di Grados...
info.title: Blue Comet SPT Layzner

info.synopsis: Protagonisti della storia sono Emirun e Rex, due ragazzi che si conoscevano nel mondo reale e che si ritrovano per caso all'interno del gioco. Per riuscire a sopravvivere in questo mondo spietato, si uniscono a un gruppo di esplorazione che cerca di raccogliere informazioni e affrontare i pericoli dei piani del castello. Un giorno, però, la loro squadra viene attaccata da un misterioso Player Killer conosciuto come il Black Swordsman. Quando Emirun arriva sul posto, trova Rex distrutto dalla disperazione e il misterioso spadaccino davanti a lui: l'intero gruppo è stato sterminato. Decisi a vendicare i compagni caduti e diventare più forti, Emirun e Rex cercano l'aiuto della leggendaria spadaccina Asuna e iniziano un duro allenamento sotto la sua guida. In un gioco mortale dove anche i giocatori possono diventare nemici, i due dovranno affrontare dolore, paura e tradimento per trovare un nuovo inizio.
info.title: Sword Art Online: Unanswered//butterfly
